turns.label: read
turns.text:
I'll help you troubleshoot the "No Service" issue. First, let me look up your customer information using your phone number.

<tool_call>
<function=get_customer_by_phone>
<parameter=phone_number>
555-123-2002
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>

turns.label: no_call
turns.text: I found your account, John. You have three lines associated with your account: L1001, L1002, and L1003. Could you tell me which phone number is showing "No Service"? Or if you know the line ID, that would help too.<|im_end|>

turns.label: no_call
turns.text:
I found the line for 555-123-2002. It's line ID L1002, and it shows as "Active" with no suspension. The line status is Active, so that's not the issue.

Since you're seeing "No Service" on your phone, let's start troubleshooting. First, can you check your phone's status bar to see what's showing? Please use the **check_status_bar** action on your phone and tell me what it displays.<|im_end|>

turns.label: no_call
turns.text:
I see the issue now. Airplane Mode is currently ON, which disables all wireless communications including cellular service. This would explain why you're seeing "No Service."

Let's turn off Airplane Mode. Please use the **toggle_airplane_mode** action on your phone to turn it OFF.<|im_end|>

turns.label: no_call
turns.text:
Airplane Mode is now off, but you're still showing "No Signal." Let's check your SIM card status next, as SIM card issues can cause a complete loss of service.

Please use the **check_sim_status** action on your phone to see the current status of your SIM card.<|im_end|>

turns.label: no_call
turns.text:
The SIM card is not being detected, which explains the "No Signal" status. This is likely because the SIM card is not properly seated in the phone.

Let's try reseating the SIM card. Please use the **reseat_sim_card** action on your phone to simulate removing and reinserting the SIM card.<|im_end|>

turns.label: no_call
turns.text:
Great! Your phone now shows excellent signal, 5G, and data enabled. The issue was that the SIM card wasn't properly seated, and reseating it resolved the problem.

Is there anything else I can help you with regarding your service or account?<|im_end|>

turns.label: no_call
turns.text: You're welcome, John! I'm glad your phone is working again. If you have any other issues in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!<|im_end|>
